Definition: of Latin origin; the "purple" mussel, i.e. (by implication) the red-blue color itself, and finally a garment dyed with it:--purple.
BiblicalUsage: Porphyra is purple, the dye from the purple mussel and the cloth dyed with it, the colour of wealth and royalty. Luke dresses the rich man in purple, and Mark shows the soldiers clothing Jesus in purple to mock him as a king.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the mockery backfired, because the purple they meant as a joke was the truth: he is the King.
